title: City of Melbourne Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE): residential dwellings by building and type, every census year 2002-2024
provider: City of Melbourne, Open Data Platform (Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1): dataset residential-dwellings
credit: CLUE: City of Melbourne, CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the dataset's metadata: license CC BY, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode; checked 2026-11-05)
citation: City of Melbourne, Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE), Residential dwellings, https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/explore/dataset/residential-dwellings/ ; definitions: https://www.melbourne.vic.gov.au/clue
format: CSV separated by semicolons, with a byte-order mark; one row a property (a building) and a dwelling type in a census year. Fields, as the dataset's metadata defines them: census_year (the year in which the census's surveying was completed); block_id (the CLUE city block, bounded mostly by major roads; about 606 in the municipality); property_id (the second tier of the property hierarchy: a building where several stand within one base property); base_property_id (the first tier: a land parcel); building_address; clue_small_area (a group of blocks); dwelling_type (Residential Apartments, House/Townhouse or Student Apartments: a simplified classification of the Council's property rates database); dwelling_number (dwellings of that type in the property); longitude, latitude (WGS 84) and location. No rents, no bedrooms, no occupancy: the stock only.
coverage: The municipality of the City of Melbourne, census years 2002 to 2024: 219,680 rows in all (checked 2026-11-05), the whole dataset, since 2,869 rows have no location (2,023 of them in 2016, holding 10,504 dwellings) and a query by box would drop them; the product places them by their property's location in other years, or else at their block's point.

municipality.description: Every residential building of the municipality, every census year (about 25 MB; fetch again with --refresh after the City adds a year)
